name: Donut Dongle gameID v0.7.24
body:
**Firmware Updates**

- DonutShop update badge now appears in upper right corner when a new version is available. Clicking shows release notes and "Update" button. Re-uses existing process.
- When viewing the Dashboard on mobile, Experimental Firmware (update) card is shown first / at the top.
- Renamed "stage and flash latest firmware" to "update to latest firmware"
